name: research-tool
description: AI-assisted research tool with templates, scripts, and MCP servers for academic thesis/dissertation projects

scripts.validate:json: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const f of ['.vscode/mcp.json','.vscode/settings.json']) { if (fs.existsSync(f)) { JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')); console.log('✅ '+f+' valid'); } else { console.log('⏭️  '+f+' missing — skipping (local VS Code config, not tracked)'); } }"
